system.description:
Make an Interface Roll (14). Once per
rest on a success, mark a Stress to
release eight daemon AI fragments
within Close range that move with you.
Place a d8 on this card set to 8,
representing the size of your daemon
army. Whenever you deal damage to a
target within Close range, you can
decrease this value by 1 to deal an
additional 1d8 techno damage.
When you take damage, you can
decrease this value by 1 to reduce the
damage by 1d8.
Each time the die is decreased, a
daemon acts on your behalf, then
disappears. When the die’s value would
be reduced below 1, return this card to
your vault.
